notes: CA uses an explicit 4-level hierarchy: Domain -> Strand -> Sub-Strand -> Foundation. Side-by-side age columns ('Early (3 to 4 ½ Years)' vs. 'Later (4 to 5 ½ Years)') MUST each become a separate indicator.

indicator.name: Initiative
indicator.description: Demonstrate initiative by starting activities (such as simple play scenarios), initiating social interactions (such as helping others), and seeking solutions to problems.

indicator.name: Initiative
indicator.description: Demonstrate initiative by starting activities (such as detailed and more complex play scenarios), initiating social interactions (such as helping others) more often, and seeking solutions to problems more persistently.

domain.name: Foundational Language Development
domain.description: This is one out of two sub-domains in the Language and Literacy Development domain.

indicator.name: Understanding and Using Vocabulary
indicator.description: Understand and use words for objects, actions, and attributes frequently experienced in everyday life, such as through play, conversations, or stories.

domain.name: Foundational Language Development
domain.description: This is one out of two sub-domains in the Language and Literacy Development domain.

indicator.name: Understanding and Using Vocabulary
indicator.description: Understand and use an increasing variety of words for objects, actions, and attributes experienced in everyday life, such as through play, conversations, or stories.

domain.name: English Language Development
domain.description: This is one out of two sub-domains in the Language and Literacy Development domain.

indicator.name: Understanding Words
indicator.description: Discovering: Pay attention to English oral language and understand a few common English words, while relying mainly on intonation, facial expressions, and gestures of the speaker in interactions with adults and peers.

domain.name: English Language Development
domain.description: This is one out of two sub-domains in the Language and Literacy Development domain.

indicator.name: Understanding Words
indicator.description: Developing: Demonstrate understanding of words in English for objects and actions as well as phrases encountered frequently in interactions with adults and peers.

domain.name: English Language Development
domain.description: This is one out of two sub-domains in the Language and Literacy Development domain.

indicator.name: Understanding Words
indicator.description: Broadening: Demonstrate understanding of a larger set of words in English (for example, objects and actions, personal pronouns, possessives, and descriptive terms) in interactions with adults and peers.

domain.name: English Language Development
domain.description: This is one out of two sub-domains in the Language and Literacy Development domain.

indicator.name: Understanding the Concept of Print
indicator.description: Discovering: Interact with materials representing the letters of the English alphabet.

domain.name: English Language Development
domain.description: This is one out of two sub-domains in the Language and Literacy Development domain.

indicator.name: Understanding the Concept of Print
indicator.description: Developing: Demonstrate awareness that they are interacting with English print.

domain.name: English Language Development
domain.description: This is one out of two sub-domains in the Language and Literacy Development domain.

indicator.name: Understanding the Concept of Print
indicator.description: Broadening: Demonstrate awareness of English print as something that can be read and has specific meaning.

regression_cases.description: PARSER: each Foundation's Early/Later age-band variants must survive parsing as separate standards with distinct standard_ids and age_bands, not collapse onto one.
regression_cases.assertion: for every (domain_code, indicator_code) group with >1 parser standard, the standard_ids and age_bands within the group are all distinct.

regression_cases.description: PARSER: every standard_id in the parser output is unique.
regression_cases.assertion: no two parser standards share a standard_id.
